Name: Shie Portraits extended (Shie-esque portraits)
Author: CrepusculeCraft
Description:
[font=Tahoma][u][size=4]DESCRIPTION:
[/size][/u][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264?tab=description]Shie's Portraits[/url] are my absolute favorite for Stardew Valley, and while Shie has been very generous in creating more portraits for other mods, there are some that were not included yet. Being the impatient artist I am, I took assets from Shie's other works and edited them to create this: Shie-esque Portraits!

[/font][size=3]Currently Covers [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5533]The Stray Catfe[/url]﻿,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5245]Khadija's Recipe Shop[/url], as well as my versions of "Adventurer's Guild" npc from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][size=3]Stardew Valley Expanded[/size]
[/url][font=Tahoma][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]
[/url][size=2]I am currently working on requests to cover other mods as well, but I will not be covering any NPC Shie already has renders for.
I will keep any of my files up if/when Shie adds their portraits to her mod, but you should really DL Shie's -w-[/size]
[u][size=4]
[/size][/u]
[/font][u][size=4]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Unzip my files to your mod folder, let them overwrite any existing files.
[/list]
[list]
[*]For Mermaid Island, you will need to go into the folder I have labeled "Put into portraiture" and.... put the pngs into your Portraiture folder where Shie's portraits are.
[*]To uninstall and restore portraits, I have left 'old' versions of the sprites, simply rename them to their original file name. (same name as my portrait)
[/list][font=Tahoma]

I have received permission from Shie to upload, but don't forget to download and ENDORSE her mod as well! I would never had been able to make these edits without her.[/font]
